purpose: Mu ban (invalid slots) recorded separately from the archived jobs, so that an infrastructure or quota failure is never silently read as a 0.0 capability score and never enters the discrimination statistics.
immutability_note: The archived jobs tree is not rewritten. jobs/result.json, jobs/<trial>/result.json and every original log stay byte-for-byte as produced by the local Outside-Harbor runner; this file is an annotation layer on top of them.

invalid_criteria: The trial's agent_result.metadata.result.status is not 'completed' (for example 'error'), or
The recorded final/error text is a provider-side transport or quota failure (HTTP 429, AccountQuotaExceeded, HTTP 5xx, timeout), or
The verifier never ran on a candidate revision (no verifier_result / no checks.json produced by a real run).
replacement_policy: An invalid slot is bound to the same planned slot: the same model alias, the same one trial per planned slot, and the same planned ordering, so a replacement never adds extra weight to a model.

A replacement run is attempted only when the failure is transport/quota/timeout and the provider budget allows it; an environment defect of our own (image, mount, permission, runner bug) is fixed first and then the whole slot is re-run.
A replacement is never a re-prompt of a failed answer: the slot is discarded in full and a fresh trial is started from the untouched workspace.
Every replacement keeps its own started_at / finished_at and its own runner identity; it is never merged into the invalid trial's record.
counting_policy: Invalid slots are excluded from model_score_sum, from testcase_pass_sum and from every discrimination claim.
They are reported separately as infra evidence (the provider endpoint can host the task, no candidate code was involved).
A task must never fail or pass on the strength of an invalid slot; only valid trials count.

slots.recorded_reward_note: The runner writes reward=0.0 for an errored trial. This value is a placeholder produced by the failure path, not a measurement of kimi-k3 on this task, and it must not be counted.

candidate_fingerprint.task_hash_algorithm: sha256 over (relative posix path + sha256(file content)) for every file in the task tree, sorted by path; jobs/, runs/, work/, results/ and caches are excluded

runner_identity.runner_sha256_note: runner.py as archived; the runner revision that actually executed this old round was not recorded with the round, so this hash is not claimed to be the execution-time revision. Every later round records the execution-time runner revision together with run_time_identity.

replacement.reason: The failure is a weekly provider quota resetting at 2026-10-12 00:00:00 +0800 CST. No re-run was attempted for this archive; the slot stays open and is re-run under the same planned slot when the quota resets.
replacement.planned_slot: candidate kimi-k3, one trial, same ordering position
